structure.en: you say you don't need it?

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ない after a verb says 'not'. ぬ is an old-fashioned form of ない. いらぬ = 'don't need it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after words shows they are what someone said. Here the 'you say' is left out, and な adds an old-man 'eh?'. いらぬとな = 'you don't need it, you say?'
